contradictions.what: Rep says nothing could be done and there was no moment, then says our analysis found things we could have fixed and arrived three weeks late.
Rep calls the account healthy and off anyone's list, but there was no business review for 9-10 months, she never met Stefan, and he says Stripe only contacted him when he said he was leaving.
Rep says they weren't really pitching because it was a renewal, but she presented the Authorization Boost deck and Adaptive Acceptance.
Rep says the uplift number got silence, but Stefan responded with explicit objections to the average.
Rep says nobody wanted to rip anything out, but the customer asked to split the contract and moved international to local acquiring.
Decision went to the CFO two weeks before the last call, yet our analysis landed three weeks after the ask, so the decision may have been made before it arrived.
Rep describes Stefan's analysis as showing bad markets but never saw it and cannot name the markets precisely.
